title: Keyboard and input
description: Keyboard layout, mouse, touchpad and shortcuts.

sections.title: Keyboard
sections.description: Layout changes apply right away and ask for confirmation, so a wrong layout reverts on its own.

sections.title: Mouse and pointer
sections.description: Pointer speed, acceleration, scrolling and focus for all apps.

sections.title: Touchpad
sections.description: Taps, clicks and scrolling of the laptop touchpad.

sections.title: Scrolling in shell lists
sections.description: Only the bar, panels and launcher; apps follow the Mouse and Touchpad sections.

sections.title: Keyboard shortcuts
sections.description: Every key combination currently active; Super+F1 shows a summary of the main ones anywhere.

entries.label: Keyboard layouts
entries.description: Layouts you can switch between; the first one is the default.

entries.label: Layout variants
entries.description: Variant of each layout, separated by commas in the same order; leave empty for the default.

entries.label: Extra keyboard options
entries.description: Change special keys, e.g. caps:escape turns Caps Lock into Escape, grp:alt_shift_toggle switches layout with Alt+Shift.
entries.help: The full list is in `man xkeyboard-config`.

entries.label: Repeat rate
entries.description: Characters per second while a key is held down.

entries.label: Repeat delay
entries.description: How long a key must be held before it starts repeating.

entries.label: Num Lock on at login
entries.description: The number pad types digits from the start of the session.

entries.label: Pointer speed
entries.description: Slower (−1) or faster (+1) than the device's own speed.

entries.label: Acceleration
entries.description: Whether moving the mouse faster also makes the pointer travel further.

options.label: Device default
options.description: Whatever the device and libinput choose.

options.label: Flat
options.description: Same distance at any speed; preferred for games.

entries.label: Reverse wheel direction
entries.description: Rolling the wheel down moves the content up, like on a phone.

entries.label: Wheel scroll speed
entries.description: How far apps scroll per wheel notch of an external mouse; 1× is the normal distance.

entries.label: Which window gets the keyboard
entries.description: Choose whether typing goes to the window under the pointer or to the one you clicked.

options.label: On click
options.description: A window gets the keyboard only when you click it.

options.label: Under the pointer
options.description: Moving the pointer over a window gives it the keyboard.

options.label: Pointer free, keyboard on click
options.description: Scrolling and hovering reach the window under the pointer; typing goes to the last one you clicked.

options.label: Fully independent
options.description: The pointer never moves the keyboard focus, not even when you click.

entries.label: Focus after closing a window
entries.description: Which window gets the keyboard when the active one closes.

options.label: Next in the layout
options.description: Hyprland picks the window next to the closed one.

options.label: Under the pointer
options.description: The window the pointer is over.

options.label: Last used
options.description: The window you used just before the closed one.

entries.label: Hide idle cursor
entries.description: Seconds without movement before the pointer hides; 0 never hides it.

entries.label: Hide the pointer while typing
entries.description: Pressing any key hides the pointer until you move the mouse again.

entries.label: Ignore while typing
entries.description: Touches do nothing while you type, so your palm does not move the pointer.

entries.label: Tap to click
entries.description: Tap with one, two or three fingers for left, right and middle click.

entries.label: Tap and drag
entries.description: Tap, then touch again and move to drag; lifting the finger drops the item.

entries.label: Keep dragging after lifting
entries.description: Lets you lift the finger during a tap-and-drag, e.g. to reach the other side of the touchpad.

options.label: Off
options.description: Lifting the finger drops the item.

options.label: Briefly
options.description: The drag ends if you do not touch again shortly after lifting.

options.label: Until you tap
options.description: The drag continues until you tap once more.

entries.label: Natural scrolling
entries.description: Content follows your fingers, like on a phone.

entries.label: Scroll speed
entries.description: How far apps scroll for the same finger movement; 1× is the normal distance.

entries.label: Click by number of fingers
entries.description: Pressing with two or three fingers gives right or middle click, instead of pressing the bottom corners.

entries.label: Custom scrolling in shell lists
entries.description: Shell lists and panels use the speeds below; off uses Qt's standard scrolling.

entries.label: Pixels per wheel notch
entries.description: How far a shell list moves for each notch of the mouse wheel.
keywords: Velocidad de la rueda del ratón

entries.label: Touchpad speed
entries.description: How far a shell list moves for the same finger movement; higher scrolls further.

entries.label: Mouse or touchpad detection
entries.description: Leave it at 120 unless your mouse is detected as a touchpad; 120 equals one wheel notch.
entries.help: Scroll events at or above this value count as wheel notches; smaller ones count as touchpad movement.
keywords: Umbral del paso de la rueda

entries.label: Active shortcuts
entries.description: Every key binding Hyprland has loaded; add your own in hypr/custom/keybinds.lua.
